title: The preview mode of the OPC (OnPage Composer) page builder of JTL-Shop is activated by a request parameter alone and…
description: The OPC (OnPage Composer) page builder in JTL-Shop allows preview mode activation solely via a request parameter without verifying authenticated backend sessions. This flaw enables an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject script code that executes in the browser of any visitor or administrator who opens a crafted link. For administrators, this can lead to actions performed with their privileges. Additionally, third-party plugins that evaluate portlet property values as templates may execute arbitrary template code via the same vulnerability, although this does not affect JTL-Shop's own portlets.
